name: devkit
description: Four on-demand skill hubs for AI-assisted development. Each hub is a short router: invoke it and it lists references plus when to read each, so only the depth a task needs enters context. agent-development (LangChain + LangGraph agents and workflows), design (web pages via the bundled Dolle-MCP server, native/desktop GUIs, UI craft, design systems, Core Web Vitals), shipping (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and Terraform), and process (turning a vague ask into a precise prompt, an app idea into a build-ready spec, decomposing work across subagents, and a documentation method). Only the four descriptions sit in startup context; 92% of the content is deferred to references read on demand.
